zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-game-build.description: Build a risk-matched whitebox or the approved production game by adapting to the host environment's available rendering stacks, 3D/2D generators, and modeling tools. Turn GAME_DESIGN and ART_DIRECTION into a concise BUILD_BRIEF and a runnable game candidate with deterministic self-checks. Use for prototype the riskiest design question, implement the approved game design, or turn this design into a running 2D, 2.5D, or 3D game. 游戏构建执行。结合本机与宿主环境实际可用的渲染栈与生成/建模工具（如 Three.js、混元 3D 等 3D 模型、Blender、2D/音视频工具），先针对头号设计风险搭建白盒原型，或将已批准的 GAME_DESIGN 与 ART_DIRECTION 实现为可运行游戏并配齐自检。用于验证核心设计风险、构建游戏原型或实现正式可玩版本。

zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-game-design.description: Select a playable game concept, design world rules, systems, levels, and branching narrative, and define visual and audio art direction. Turns SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF into CONCEPT, GAME_DESIGN, and ART_DIRECTION as distinct stage-owned specifications without writing implementation code. Use for what game should this novel become, compare game concepts, choose a game direction, design the game world and levels, write the game design document, design branching story or interactive film scenes, set the art direction, or define the visual style. 游戏策划与美术方向。基于 SOURCE_BIBLE 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF…

zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-game-qa.description: Blind-playtest and verify a game on its target runtime as a first-time player without reading source code. Run an isolated zero-knowledge playthrough first to uncover onboarding, guidance, interaction, pacing, and mobile viewport issues, then reconcile against design specs and record one complete-run verification receipt. Use for blind playtest a generated game, QA a game build as a new player, audit first-run playability, or verify a game build. 游戏实机盲玩与运行验收。先以未读源码与设计文档的新玩家身份在目标运行环境中从头盲玩，排查上手引导、交互动线、视听节奏与视口适配问题，再对照设计规范核实定性，并用单次完整通关记录生成验收凭证。用于新玩家视角盲测游戏、诊断实机体验问题或验收构建版本。

zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-novel-game-ana.description: Deconstruct a novel for game adaptation. Turn a raw novel, chapter-analysis library, or writing project into a cited SOURCE_BIBLE covering main story arcs, standout conflict scenes, character relationships and agendas, dual-timeline secrets, world rules, signature spaces and props, and adaptation boundaries — without locking a game genre prematurely. Use for novel-to-game analysis, deconstruct a book for game adaptation, extract story arcs, key scenes, characters, and world rules from a novel. 小说游戏化拆书。把原始小说、拆文成果或写作工程整理成带原文出处的…

zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-novel-to-game.description: Turn a novel into a fully playable game on the selected target platform. Orchestrates the whole adaptation pipeline — requirements intake, gameable deconstruction, concept, world and visual design, environment-adapted build, and blind-playtest QA — for a novel in any language. Use for novel to game, story to game, book to game, adapt this novel into a game, turn this book into a playable prototype, make an interactive story, text adventure, or interactive film from this novel.
